'''Mike Rebman'''<ref name="dt-12045">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12045 Speeders From Hell; Part I], DeckTech (Mike "Thunder" Rebman, 27 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12045/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12045/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018091300/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12045/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Thunder''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] Biker Scout list on DeckTech in November 2000.
